camel_example: aliyun eiam GetApplicationSsoConfig --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --ApplicationId app_mkv7rgt4d7i4u7zqtzev2mxxxx
description_en: Retrieves the single sign-on (SSO) configuration for an application in EIAM
description_zh: 查询一个EIAM应用的单点登录SSO配置属性
kebab_example: aliyun eiam get-application-sso-config --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --application-id app_mkv7rgt4d7i4u7zqtzev2mxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetApplicationSsoConfig

ApplicationSsoConfig.description_en: The SSO configuration of the application
ApplicationSsoConfig.description_zh: 应用单点登录SSO配置信息

InitLoginType.description_en:
The SSO initiation method. Valid values:

only_app_init_sso: SSO is initiated only by the application. This is the default value for OIDC applications. If this method is used for a SAML application, you must specify InitLoginUrl.

idaas_or_app_init_sso: SSO can be initiated by the IDaaS console or the application. This is the default value for SAML applications. If this method is used for an OIDC application, you must specify InitLoginUrl
InitLoginType.description_zh:
初始化单点登录SSO方式，取值可选范围：
only_app_init_sso：仅应用发起SSO，OIDC协议应用默认取值。当SAML应用指定为该方式时，InitLoginUrl必须指定。
idaas_or_app_init_sso：支持IDaaS门户或者应用发起SSO，SAML协议应用默认取值范围。当OIDC协议指定为该方式时，InitLoginUrl必须指定

InitLoginUrl.description_en: The URL that triggers SSO. This parameter is required when InitLoginType for an OIDC application is set to idaas_or_app_init_sso. This parameter is also required when InitLoginType for a SAML application is set to only_app_init_sso
InitLoginUrl.description_zh: 初始化单点登录SSO触发地址，当OIDC协议应用InitLoginType为idaas_or_app_init_sso，必须指定；当SAML协议应用InitLoginType为only_app_init_sso时，必须指定
InitLoginUrl.title_en: 仅SP-init情况下，SP指定的登录地址
InitLoginUrl.title_zh: 仅SP-init情况下，SP指定的登录地址

OidcSsoConfig.description_en: The SSO configuration parameters for the application that uses OpenID Connect (OIDC). This parameter is returned only when the application uses OIDC for SSO
OidcSsoConfig.description_zh: OIDC协议的应用SSO属性配置参数。当且仅当应用SSO协议为OIDC类型时返回

AccessTokenEffectiveTime.description_en: The validity period of the access token. Unit: seconds. Default value: 1200 (20 minutes)
AccessTokenEffectiveTime.description_zh: 签发的access token有效时间，单位为秒，默认1200秒（20分钟）

AllowedPublicClient.description_en: Indicates whether the application is allowed to make requests to the IDaaS EIAM authorization server as a public client. This feature is supported only for the authorization code and device code grant types. Default value: false
AllowedPublicClient.description_zh: 应用是否允许作为公共客户端请求IDaaS EIAM授权服务器。只支持授权码模式和设备模式启用，默认为false

CodeEffectiveTime.description_en: The validity period of the authorization code. Unit: seconds. Default value: 60 (1 minute)
CodeEffectiveTime.description_zh: 签发的code有效时间，单位为秒，默认为60秒（1分钟）

CustomClaims.description_en: The custom claims that are returned in the ID token
CustomClaims.description_zh: 自定义id token返回包含的用户信息

ClaimValueExpression.description_en: The expression used to generate the value of the claim

GrantScopes.description_en: The OIDC-compliant scope parameter. This parameter specifies the scope of user attributes that can be returned by the userinfo endpoint or included in the ID token
GrantScopes.description_zh: OIDC协议标准参数 scope，用于指定userinfo端点或者id_token可以返回的用户属性范围

items.description_en:
The OIDC-compliant scope parameter. This parameter specifies the scope of user attributes that can be returned by the userinfo endpoint or included in the ID token. Valid values:

openid: An OIDC-compliant parameter that specifies the unique ID of the user.

profile: The user profile.

email: The user's email address.

phone: The user's mobile number
items.description_zh:
OIDC协议标准参数 scope，用于指定userinfo端点或者id_token可以返回的用户属性范围，取值可选范围：
openid：OIDC标准参数，用户唯一id。
profile：用户详细信息。
email：用户邮箱信息。
phone：用户手机信息

GrantTypes.description_en: The list of OIDC grant types that are supported
GrantTypes.description_zh: 支持的OIDC协议授权模式列表

items.description_en:
The OIDC grant type. Valid values:

authorization_code: Authorization code.

implicit: Implicit.

refresh_token: Refresh token.

urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:device_code: Device code.

password: Password
items.description_zh:
支持的OIDC协议授权模式，取值可选范围：
authorization_code：授权码模式。
implicit：隐式模式。
refresh_token：令牌刷新模式。
urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:device_code：设备模式。
password：密码模式

IdTokenEffectiveTime.description_en: The validity period of the ID token. Unit: seconds. Default value: 300 (5 minutes)
IdTokenEffectiveTime.description_zh: 签发的id token有效时间，单位为秒，默认为300秒（5分钟）

PasswordAuthenticationSourceId.description_en: The ID of the authentication source for password-based logon. This parameter is valid only if GrantTypes for the OIDC application is set to password
PasswordAuthenticationSourceId.description_zh: 密码模式使用的身份认证源ID，当且仅当OIDC协议应用指定的GrantTypes包含password模式才生效
PasswordAuthenticationSourceId.title_en: 密码模式使用的身份认证来源id
PasswordAuthenticationSourceId.title_zh: 密码模式使用的身份认证来源id

PasswordTotpMfaRequired.description_en: Indicates whether Time-based One-Time Password (TOTP) multi-factor authentication (MFA) is required for password-based logon. This parameter is valid only if GrantTypes for the OIDC application is set to password
PasswordTotpMfaRequired.description_zh: 密码模式是否强制需要TOTP二次认证，当且仅当OIDC协议应用指定的GrantTypes包含password模式才生效
PasswordTotpMfaRequired.title_en: 密码模式是否强制需要TOTP二次认证
PasswordTotpMfaRequired.title_zh: 密码模式是否强制需要TOTP二次认证

PkceChallengeMethods.description_en: The algorithm used to calculate the code challenge in PKCE

items.description_en:
The algorithm used to calculate the code challenge in PKCE. Valid values:

plain: Plaintext.

S256: SHA-256
items.description_zh:
PKCE中计算Code Challenge的算法，取值可选范围：
plain：原文。
S256：SHA 256算法

PkceRequired.description_en: Indicates whether Proof Key for Code Exchange (PKCE) is required for the application SSO. For more information, see RFC 7636

PostLogoutRedirectUris.description_en: The list of post-logout redirect URIs
PostLogoutRedirectUris.description_zh: 应用支持Logout登出回调地址列表

items.description_en: The post-logout redirect URI that is added to the whitelist. When the application initiates a logout request, you can specify the post_logout_redirect_uri parameter
items.description_zh: 应用的Logout登出回调白名单地址，应用发起Logout请求时可以指定post_logout_redirect_uri参数

RedirectUris.description_en: The list of redirect URIs that the application supports

items.description_en: The redirect URI that the application supports

RefreshTokenEffective.description_en: The validity period of the refresh token. Unit: seconds. Default value: 86400 (1 day)
RefreshTokenEffective.description_zh: 签发的refresh token有效时间，单位为秒，默认为86400秒（1天）

ResponseTypes.description_en: The response type that the application supports. This parameter is returned only if OidcSsoConfig.GrantTypes is set to implicit
ResponseTypes.description_zh: 当OidcSsoConfig.GrantTypes包含指定implicit隐式模式后，应用支持的返回类型

items.description_en:
The OIDC-compliant response_type parameter. This parameter is valid only if GrantTypes is set to implicit. Valid values:

token: Returns only an access token.

id_token: Returns only an ID token.

token id_token: Returns both an access token and an ID token
items.description_zh:
OIDC协议标准参数ResponseType，只有指定了GrantTypes包含implicit隐式模式才生效，取值可选范围：
token：只返回access token。
id_token：只返回id token。
token id_token：同时返回access token和id token

ResponseTypes.title_en: 隐式流支持的返回类型
ResponseTypes.title_zh: 隐式流支持的返回类型

SubjectIdExpression.description_en: The expression used to generate the value of the sub claim in the ID token
SubjectIdExpression.description_zh: 自定义id token返回的sub取值表达式

ProtocolEndpointDomain.description_en: The configuration of the metadata endpoint provided by the application
ProtocolEndpointDomain.description_zh: 应用提供的Metadata 端点配置信息

Oauth2AuthorizationEndpoint.description_en: The OAuth 2.0 authorization endpoint. This parameter is returned only when the application uses OIDC for SSO
Oauth2AuthorizationEndpoint.description_zh: oAuth2 授权端点。当且仅当应用SSO协议为OIDC类型时返回

Oauth2DeviceAuthorizationEndpoint.description_en: The OAuth 2.0 device authorization endpoint. This parameter is returned only when the application uses OIDC for SSO
Oauth2DeviceAuthorizationEndpoint.description_zh: oAuth2 Device 授权端点。当且仅当应用SSO协议为OIDC类型时返回

Oauth2RevokeEndpoint.description_en: The OAuth 2.0 token revocation endpoint. This parameter is returned only when the application uses OIDC for SSO
Oauth2RevokeEndpoint.description_zh: oAuth2 Token吊销端点。当且仅当应用SSO协议为OIDC类型时返回
Oauth2RevokeEndpoint.title_en: OIDC access token 吊销端点
Oauth2RevokeEndpoint.title_zh: OIDC access token 吊销端点

Oauth2TokenEndpoint.description_en: The OAuth 2.0 token endpoint. This parameter is returned only when the application uses OIDC for SSO
Oauth2TokenEndpoint.description_zh: oAuth2 Token端点。当且仅当应用SSO协议为OIDC类型时返回
Oauth2TokenEndpoint.title_en: oauth2 access token 换取端点
Oauth2TokenEndpoint.title_zh: oauth2 access token 换取端点

Oauth2UserinfoEndpoint.description_en: The OIDC userinfo endpoint. This parameter is returned only when the application uses OIDC for SSO
Oauth2UserinfoEndpoint.description_zh: OIDC 获取用户信息端点。当且仅当应用SSO协议为OIDC类型时返回
Oauth2UserinfoEndpoint.title_en: OIDC 获取用户信息端点
Oauth2UserinfoEndpoint.title_zh: OIDC 获取用户信息端点

OidcIssuer.description_en: The OIDC issuer. This parameter is returned only when the application uses OIDC for SSO
OidcIssuer.description_zh: OIDC issuer信息。当且仅当应用SSO协议为OIDC类型时返回

OidcJwksEndpoint.description_en: The JSON Web Key Set (JWKS) endpoint for OIDC. This parameter is returned only when the application uses OIDC for SSO
OidcJwksEndpoint.description_zh: OIDC jwks地址。当且仅当应用SSO协议为OIDC类型时返回

OidcLogoutEndpoint.description_en: The OIDC Relying Party (RP)-initiated logout endpoint. This parameter is returned only when the application uses OIDC for SSO
OidcLogoutEndpoint.description_zh: OIDC RP-initiated Logout Endpoint。当且仅当应用SSO协议为OIDC类型时返回

SamlMetaEndpoint.description_en: The metadata endpoint for the SAML protocol. This parameter is returned only when the application uses SAML 2.0 for SSO
SamlMetaEndpoint.description_zh: SAML协议的Metadata元数据地址。当且仅当应用SSO协议为SAML 2.0时返回

SamlSsoEndpoint.description_en: The endpoint that receives AuthnRequest requests for the SAML protocol. This parameter is returned only when the application uses SAML 2.0 for SSO
SamlSsoEndpoint.description_zh: SAML协议AuthnRequest请求接受地址。当且仅当应用SSO协议为SAML 2.0时返回

SamlSsoConfig.description_en: The SSO configuration parameters for the application that uses Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML) 2.0. This parameter is returned only when the application uses SAML 2.0 for SSO
SamlSsoConfig.description_zh: SAML协议的应用SSO属性配置参数。当且仅当应用SSO协议为SAML 2.0时返回

AssertionSigned.description_en:
Indicates whether the assertion needs to be signed. ResponseSigned and AssertionSigned cannot both be false.

true: The assertion must be signed.

false: The assertion does not need to be signed
AssertionSigned.description_zh:
Assertion是否需要签名。ResponseSigned和AssertionSigned不能同时为false。
true：需要签名。
false：不需要签名

AttributeStatements.description_en: The configuration of additional user attributes in the SAML assertion
AttributeStatements.description_zh: 在SAML断言中包含的额外用户属性配置

AttributeName.description_en: The name of the attribute in the SAML assertion

AttributeValueExpression.description_en: The expression used to generate the value of the attribute in the SAML assertion
AttributeValueExpression.description_zh: SAML断言中的属性取值表达式

DefaultRelayState.description_en: The default value of RelayState. If the SSO is initiated by EIAM, the RelayState in the SAML response is set to this value
DefaultRelayState.description_zh: 默认RelayState取值。当用户的单点登录SSO请求是由EIAM发起时，EIAM提供的SAML Response会指定RelayState为当前值

IdPEntityId.description_en: The EntityID of the identity provider (IdP) in the SAML protocol
IdPEntityId.description_zh: SAML协议中代表IdP身份的Entity Id

NameIdFormat.description_en:
The format of the NameID in the SAML protocol. Valid values:

urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:unspecified: Unspecified. The application determines how to parse the NameID.

urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress: Email address format.

urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:nameid-format:persistent: Persistent NameID.

urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:nameid-format:transient: Transient NameID
NameIdFormat.description_zh:
SAML协议标准的NameID格式，取值可选范围：
urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:unspecified：未指定的，由应用自行决定解析NameID。
urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress：Email地址格式。
urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:nameid-format:persistent：持久化的NameID。
urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:nameid-format:transient：瞬时的NameID

NameIdValueExpression.description_en: The expression used to generate the value of the NameID in the SAML assertion
NameIdValueExpression.description_zh: SAML协议的NameID真实取值生成表达式

OptionalRelayStates.description_en: The optional RelayState values. The display names of multiple redirect URLs are shown on the application card in the application portal. After a user clicks a URL and completes the SSO, the user is redirected to the URL. You must specify a default redirect URL before you can specify optional RelayState values
OptionalRelayStates.description_zh: 可选的RelayState。用户在应用门户的应用卡片中，显示多个可选跳转地址的显示名称，用户点击并完成 SSO 后，自动跳转到对应地址。需要填写默认跳转地址后才可填写

DisplayName.description_en: The display name of the RelayState

RelayState.description_en: The optional RelayState value. The display names of multiple redirect URLs are shown on the application card in the application portal. After a user clicks a URL and completes the SSO, the user is redirected to the URL
RelayState.description_zh: 可选的RelayState。用户在应用门户的应用卡片中，显示多个可选跳转地址的显示名称，用户点击并完成 SSO 后，自动跳转到对应地址

ResponseSigned.description_en:
Indicates whether the response needs to be signed. ResponseSigned and AssertionSigned cannot both be false.

true: The response must be signed.

false: The response does not need to be signed
ResponseSigned.description_zh:
Response是否需要签名。ResponseSigned和AssertionSigned不能同时为false。
true：需要签名。
false：不需要签名

SignatureAlgorithm.description_en: The signature algorithm for the SAML assertion

SpEntityId.description_en: The SAML EntityID of the application (service provider)

SpSsoAcsUrl.description_en: The SAML assertion consumer service (ACS) URL of the application (service provider)

SsoStatus.description_en:
The status of the SSO feature for the application. Valid values:

enabled: Enabled.

disabled: Disabled
SsoStatus.description_zh:
应用 SSO 功能启用状态，取值可选范围：
enabled：应用中。
disabled：禁用中
SsoStatus.title_en: 应用 SSO 启用状态
SsoStatus.title_zh: 应用 SSO 启用状态
